description.text:
Indigo (靛) is one of the two booster packs of Sword & Shield: Vivid Portrayals (浓墨重彩), the second Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 18 August 2023 alongside Obsidian (黎). Vivid Portrayals brought Amazing Rare (A) cards to the Simplified Chinese game for the first time: Legendary and Mythical Pokémon with special art and finish, whose attacks need Energy of several types. Packs held 5 or 25 cards.

Indigo holds the Water, Lightning, Psychic and Darkness Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them. Eternatus VMAX is on its cover, and its Amazing Rares are Kyogre, Raikou and Zacian. Its other VMAX cards are Galarian Darmanitan, Drednaw, Alcremie and Crobat VMAX, and it has Cramorant and Arrokuda, which work together. Its main cards are numbered out of 115; shiny, full-art, shiny full-art, rainbow and gold cards run to 143.
